lines.zh: 我没有脚，两片颚先滑过去。
lines.en: No feet. My two jaws slide ahead of me.

lines.zh: 牙齿碰着牙齿，一路打拍子。
lines.en: Tooth against tooth, keeping time as I go.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飘，像被谁拖着的影子。
lines.en: I drift low, a shadow dragged by someone else.

lines.zh: 草叶擦过我的颚，留下绿色的汁。
lines.en: Grass scrapes my jaw and leaves green juice.

lines.zh: 走近时我没有声音，只有开合。
lines.en: I make no sound coming, only opening and closing.

lines.zh: 两片颚中间夹着 Evolite 的碎屑。
lines.en: Evolite grit is caught between my jaws.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，再回头咬它一口。
lines.en: I drift around the stone, then turn and bite it.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的牙齿比身体先被看见。
lines.en: In the dark, my teeth are seen before my body.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是为了让你多等一会。
lines.en: I walk slowly so you wait a little longer.

lines.zh: 颚骨张开一尺，又轻轻合上。
lines.en: My jaws open a foot, then close gently.

lines.zh: 泥土被我的下颚犁出一道浅沟。
lines.en: My lower jaw plows a shallow line in the dirt.

lines.zh: 别数我的步子，我没有留下脚印。
lines.en: Don't count my steps. I leave no prints.

lines.zh: 我把牙磨得很慢，像在思考。
lines.en: I grind my teeth slowly, as if thinking.

lines.zh: 空气里有铁味，我尝了一下。
lines.en: There is iron in the air. I tasted it.

lines.zh: 我挂在黑暗里，等一样会动的东西。
lines.en: I hang in the dark, waiting for something that moves.

lines.zh: 两片颚轻轻分开，又合拢。
lines.en: My two jaws part softly, then meet.

lines.zh: 刚才那口没咬到，只是试探。
lines.en: That last bite missed. It was only a test.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，所以你看不出我在等。
lines.en: I don't breathe, so you can't tell I'm waiting.

lines.zh: Evolite 的碎屑在我口中发凉。
lines.en: Evolite crumbs lie cold inside my mouth.

lines.zh: 有只虫子爬过我的齿，我放它走了。
lines.en: A bug crawled over my teeth. I let it go.

lines.zh: 我咬住自己的影子，咬了个空。
lines.en: I bit my own shadow and caught nothing.

lines.zh: 这片林子太安静，我咬断了一根树枝。
lines.en: This wood is too quiet, so I bit through a branch.

lines.zh: 我在等哪个笨蛋把手伸进来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for some fool to reach inside.

lines.zh: 上下颚之间，只有风和一点口水。
lines.en: Between my jaws: only wind and a little drool.

lines.zh: 我试着眨眼，可我根本没有眼。
lines.en: I try to blink, but I have no eyes at all.

lines.zh: 夜里我数牙齿，数到一半忘了。
lines.en: At night I count my teeth and lose track halfway.

lines.zh: 两片颚一起转过来，对着你。
lines.en: Both jaws turn at once, pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你站得很直，看起来很难咬。
lines.en: You stand very straight. You look hard to bite.

lines.zh: 我在看你喉咙动的那一下。
lines.en: I'm watching the movement of your throat.

lines.zh: 别笑，我看不清表情，只看得见牙。
lines.en: Don't smile. I can't read faces, only teeth.

lines.zh: 你身上有 Evolite，我闻得出来。
lines.en: You carry Evolite. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我张开一点，让你看清里面有多黑。
lines.en: I open a little so you see how dark it is inside.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就往前飘一寸。
lines.en: You step back. I drift forward an inch.

lines.zh: 我记住你的高度了，下次好对准。
lines.en: I've memorized your height. Next time I'll aim better.

lines.zh: 你没有角，也没有壳，真好。
lines.en: No horns, no shell. How convenient.

lines.zh: 我的注视没有温度，别多想。
lines.en: My stare carries no warmth. Don't read into it.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的次数太多，说明你怕。
lines.en: You blink too often. That means you're afraid.

lines.zh: 我把头歪向一边，只是颚骨在响。
lines.en: I tilt my head, but it's only jawbone creaking.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: The torch in your hand is shaking. I see it.

lines.zh: 看着你，我忽然不饿了。
lines.en: Looking at you, I'm suddenly not hungry.

lines.zh: 我把颚抬起来，对着你的脸。
lines.en: I lift both jaws toward your face.

lines.zh: 你蹲下时，我数你的手指。
lines.en: While you crouch, I count your fingers.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我嘴里，很凉。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into my mouth, cool.

lines.zh: 你后退，我的颚跟着张大了。
lines.en: You step back and my jaws open wider.

lines.zh: 牙关一松，我咬到了自己的舌头。
lines.en: My jaws slackened and I bit my own tongue.

lines.zh: 疼，但疼得很遥远。
lines.en: It hurts, but the pain feels far away.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的下颚歪向左边。
lines.en: That blow left my lower jaw slanting left.

lines.zh: Evolite 的碎屑从我裂口掉出来。
lines.en: Evolite crumbs spill from my split.

lines.zh: 这一下，我听见自己缺了一颗牙。
lines.en: That blow told me I lost a tooth.

lines.zh: 别打颚骨，那是唯一硬的地方。
lines.en: Don't hit the jawbone. It's my only hard part.

lines.zh: 我退到阴影里，重新咬合。
lines.en: I retreat into shadow and reset my bite.

lines.zh: 疼得我张着嘴，合不上。
lines.en: It hurts so much my mouth hangs open.

lines.zh: 你打折了我咬东西的那一半。
lines.en: You broke the half of me that bites.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我会记在你的气味上。
lines.en: I'll remember this wound on your scent.

lines.zh: 把麦子收起来，我嚼不动草。
lines.en: Put the wheat away. I can't chew grass.

lines.zh: 肉也别晃，我要自己追。
lines.en: Don't wave meat either. I prefer the chase.

lines.zh: 你举着胡萝卜，我只看见了手指。
lines.en: You hold a carrot. I only see fingers.

lines.zh: Evolite 才算诱饵，别的都太软。
lines.en: Only Evolite counts as bait. The rest is soft.

lines.zh: 别用食物哄我，用你的心跳。
lines.en: Don't coax me with food. Use your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 那袋种子响得烦人，拿远些。
lines.en: That bag of seeds is noisy. Move it away.

lines.zh: 我不吃熟的，也不吃你递的。
lines.en: I don't eat cooked things, or anything offered.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来喂我，正好够近。
lines.en: You crouch to feed me. That's close enough.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口苹果，又吐了。
lines.en: I bit the apple once and spat it out.

lines.zh: 留着你的面包，我要的是会跑的。
lines.en: Keep your bread. I want something that runs.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的颚，牙磕了一下。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my jaw and my teeth clacked.

lines.zh: 我没有身体可以撞疼，只有牙会响。
lines.en: I have no body to bruise, only teeth to clack.

lines.zh: 你把我顶开，我顺势咬了空气。
lines.en: You shoved me aside. I bit the air on the way.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我的下颚脱了半寸。
lines.en: That knock shifted my lower jaw half an inch.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我的牙关会自己合。
lines.en: Not so close. My jaws close on their own.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子，我听见了。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow. I heard it.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你比我软。
lines.en: We collided. You are softer than I am.

lines.zh: 颚骨碰颚骨，发出一声闷响。
lines.en: Jawbone against jawbone made a dull knock.

lines.zh: 我退开时，牙齿刮到了你的袖子。
lines.en: As I pulled back, my teeth scraped your sleeve.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就当你在喂我。
lines.en: Bump me again and I'll take it as feeding.

lines.zh: 世上只有一张这样的嘴，没有第二张。
lines.en: There is only one mouth like mine.

lines.zh: 我不成对，我只分裂。
lines.en: I don't pair. I split.

lines.zh: 两片颚就是我的全部亲缘。
lines.en: My two jaws are the whole of my family.

lines.zh: 别替我找伴，我连自己都嫌吵。
lines.en: Don't find me a mate. I find myself noisy.

lines.zh: 求偶要唱歌，而我只会咬。
lines.en: Courtship needs song. I only bite.

lines.zh: Evolite 会造出新的我，不必拥抱。
lines.en: Evolite makes new ones. No embrace required.

lines.zh: 我把旧牙留在石头上，算后代。
lines.en: I leave old teeth on stone. Those are my heirs.

lines.zh: 靠近另一张嘴，只会互相咬碎。
lines.en: Two mouths close together only break each other.

lines.zh: 夜里我对着倒影张合，不算亲吻。
lines.en: At night I open and close at my reflection. Not a kiss.

lines.zh: 等我长出第三片颚，再说这事。
lines.en: Ask me again when I grow a third jaw.

lines.zh: 我没有手，东西掉进嘴里就是我的。
lines.en: No hands. Whatever falls in my mouth is mine.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑，我用牙咬住拖了两步。
lines.en: I caught your dropped sword and dragged it two steps.

lines.zh: 别把东西放在我颚边，我会合上。
lines.en: Don't set things by my jaw. I will close.

lines.zh: 我叼不起软的东西，只会咬穿。
lines.en: I can't carry soft things. I bite through them.

lines.zh: 这块骨头不错，我含着走。
lines.en: This bone is good. I'll carry it in my teeth.

lines.zh: 东西进了我嘴里，就别想要回去。
lines.en: Once it's in my mouth, don't ask for it back.

lines.zh: 我用上颚顶开箱子，里面是空的。
lines.en: I nudge the chest open with my upper jaw. Empty.

lines.zh: Evolite 我会收好，别的东西吐掉。
lines.en: I keep the Evolite and spit out the rest.

lines.zh: 你手里的面包掉下来，我接住了。
lines.en: Your bread fell and I caught it.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，只是不想你走。
lines.en: I bit your trouser leg. I just don't want you to go.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太规律，我锁定了它。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is too regular. I've locked on.

lines.zh: 我从下风处闻到了你。
lines.en: I caught your scent from downwind.

lines.zh: 那道呼吸声，我从三棵树外就听见了。
lines.en: I heard that breathing from three trees away.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝还在响，我循声来了。
lines.en: The twig you broke is still ringing. I followed it.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来血会更快。
lines.en: Don't run. Running only hurries your blood.

lines.zh: 我把你归进会动的东西这一类。
lines.en: I filed you under things that move.

lines.zh: 你身上有火把的烟，很好找。
lines.en: You carry torch smoke. Very easy to find.

lines.zh: 我不是饿，我只想确认牙齿还利。
lines.en: I'm not hungry. I just want to test my teeth.

lines.zh: 两只眼睛在草里看我，我也在看它们。
lines.en: Two eyes watch me from the grass. I watch back.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，那里没有第二条路。
lines.en: You backed to the wall. There's no second way out.

lines.zh: 我的颚自己张开了，不归我管。
lines.en: My jaws opened by themselves. Not my decision.

lines.zh: Evolite 的光把你的位置画出来了。
lines.en: The Evolite glow drew your position for me.

lines.zh: 挑中你，只因为你落单了。
lines.en: I picked you only because you were alone.

lines.zh: 你还没发现，我已经跟了半里地。
lines.en: You haven't noticed. I've trailed you half a mile.

lines.zh: 草里的动静停了一下，就是它。
lines.en: The rustling stops for a beat; that is it.

lines.zh: 你翻过矮墙，我记住了落点。
lines.en: You hop the low wall and I mark where you land.

lines.zh: 你的影子往哪偏，我就往哪偏。
lines.en: Wherever your shadow leans, I lean the same way.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我提前在拐角等。
lines.en: You turn. I'm already waiting at the corner.

lines.zh: 牙齿轻轻开合，给你的脚步打拍。
lines.en: My teeth click softly, keeping time with your steps.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头会看见我张着嘴。
lines.en: Don't turn around. You'll see my mouth open.

lines.zh: 我数到十就咬，你自己数吧。
lines.en: I bite at ten. You can count for yourself.

lines.zh: 你呼吸变快了，我的牙也跟着响。
lines.en: Your breath quickens. My teeth answer it.

lines.zh: 门在你身后，可我先到了。
lines.en: The door is behind you, but I got there first.

lines.zh: 我把你逼向亮处，那里没有掩护。
lines.en: I herd you toward the light. Nothing blocks there.

lines.zh: 你每次停下，我就近一尺。
lines.en: Every time you stop, I come a foot closer.

lines.zh: Evolite 在我齿间发烫，它认得你。
lines.en: Evolite burns between my teeth. It knows you.

lines.zh: 我等你把火把放低。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to lower the torch.

lines.zh: 你听得见我吗？我没有脚步声。
lines.en: Can you hear me? I have no footsteps.

lines.zh: 草在替你说话，它们一压就响。
lines.en: The grass speaks for you. It rustles when pressed.

lines.zh: 你吸气时，我已经到了你背后。
lines.en: While you inhale, I've already reached your back.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，牙齿几乎合上。
lines.en: I hug the ground, teeth nearly shut.

lines.zh: 你数着步子，我数你的影子。
lines.en: You count steps; I count your shadow.

lines.zh: 我在你侧面，隔着两丛蕨。
lines.en: I am beside you, past two ferns.

lines.zh: 风转了向，我把位置挪低。
lines.en: The wind turns, so I drop lower.

lines.zh: 上颚落下，像一扇门关紧。
lines.en: My upper jaw falls like a door slamming shut.

lines.zh: 我只咬一口，够你记一辈子。
lines.en: One bite is enough to last you a lifetime.

lines.zh: 牙齿陷进去，又慢慢松开。
lines.en: My teeth sink in, then slowly release.

lines.zh: 你该庆幸我只有两片颚。
lines.en: Be glad I have only two jaws.

lines.zh: 这一下，我咬到了骨头。
lines.en: This time I found the bone.

lines.zh: 血是温的，和 Evolite 不一样。
lines.en: Blood is warm. Evolite is not.

lines.zh: 我合上嘴，你听见袖子裂开。
lines.en: I close my mouth. You hear your sleeve tear.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，手比脖子更脆。
lines.en: Don't block with your hand. Hands break easier than necks.

lines.zh: 我咬空了，牙撞在一起，很疼。
lines.en: I missed. My teeth clashed and it hurt.

lines.zh: 退后三步，我就不追这一口。
lines.en: Three steps back and I'll let this bite go.

lines.zh: Evolite 的光沿着伤口渗进去。
lines.en: Evolite light seeps along the wound.

lines.zh: 你身上留下两个洞，很整齐。
lines.en: You now have two holes. Very neat ones.

lines.zh: 我嚼了嚼，味道比想象中淡。
lines.en: I chewed. You taste fainter than I imagined.

lines.zh: 下一次我会咬得更准。
lines.en: Next time I will bite more precisely.

lines.zh: 我咬住袖子，又故意松开。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve, then let go on purpose.

lines.zh: 这一口偏了，只刮到皮。
lines.en: That bite slipped and only grazed skin.

lines.zh: 两片颚先出现，中间的黑才慢慢填满。
lines.en: Two jaws appeared first. The dark filled in after.

lines.zh: 石缝里 Evolite 一闪，我便来了。
lines.en: Evolite flashed in a crack, and I arrived.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开的声音像牙齿相碰。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracked like teeth meeting.

lines.zh: 别点灯，我更喜欢从黑里长出来。
lines.en: Don't light the lamp. I prefer growing out of dark.

lines.zh: 我先咬了一口空气，确认自己活着。
lines.en: I bit the air first to confirm I was alive.

lines.zh: 这片林子有足够的阴影给我。
lines.en: This wood has enough shadow for me.

lines.zh: 我出现时，附近的鸟都不叫了。
lines.en: When I appeared, the nearby birds went silent.

lines.zh: 地面震动，我把自己从土里拔出来。
lines.en: The ground shook. I pulled myself out of the soil.

lines.zh: 有人动过进化台，我循着余味来了。
lines.en: Someone used the evolution table. I followed the taste.

lines.zh: 我悬在和你眼睛齐平的高度。
lines.en: I hang level with your eyes.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是确认四周有没有牙医。
lines.en: First thing: check whether there's a dentist nearby.

lines.zh: 我的两片颚在暗处互相找对方。
lines.en: My two jaws find each other in the dark.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声轻响，是我在磨牙。
lines.en: That soft sound you heard was me grinding.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，我刚醒来，还不太会追。
lines.en: Don't run yet. I just woke and I'm rusty.

lines.zh: 泥土裂开，我先伸出两片颚。
lines.en: The soil splits and my two jaws come out first.

lines.zh: 林子里少了一只兔子，多了一个我。
lines.en: The wood lost a rabbit and gained me.

lines.zh: 进化台的余光照到我，我就来了。
lines.en: The afterglow of the evo table reached me, and I came.

lines.zh: 我在蕨叶底下张开第一次嘴。
lines.en: Under the ferns I open my mouth the first time.

lines.zh: 火燎到牙，我尝到了焦味。
lines.en: Fire licked my teeth. I taste char.

lines.zh: 我从半空跌下，两片颚摔开了。
lines.en: I fell from the air and my jaws sprang apart.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我第一次觉得满。
lines.en: Water filled my mouth. First time I felt full.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹散，又把我吹回来。
lines.en: The blast scattered me, then blew me back.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我的牙缝里，正好。
lines.en: An arrow lodged between my teeth. How convenient.

lines.zh: 药水让我的牙变甜，很恶心。
lines.en: Potion made my teeth taste sweet. Disgusting.

lines.zh: 我饿得只剩两片颚。
lines.en: Hunger has left me with only two jaws.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我嘴里全是白光。
lines.en: Lightning struck. My mouth filled with white light.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有味道，连血也没有。
lines.en: The void has no flavor, not even blood.
